title: Agentweaver architecture diagram graph-spec
description: Structured generator input for Agentweaver draw.io diagrams. The browser-free pipeline converts this JSON to editable uncompressed draw.io XML, then exports it with the official draw.io Desktop CLI.

kind.description: Optional for backward compatibility; omitted specs are treated as graph specs.

alt.description: Markdown image alt text used in README.md / architecture-aks.md

brand.description: Optional product header shown above the graph. The logo path resolves from the renderer's public root.

compact.description: Use the compact brand treatment for fixed-size overview diagrams.

groups.description: Visual clusters (rendered as tinted rounded containers behind their member nodes), mirroring mermaid subgraphs. Tier controls nesting fill (1 = outermost).

subLabel.description: Optional explanatory line beneath the group title.

parent.description: id of an enclosing group, for nested clusters

variant.description: Optional native notation shape. Omit or use card for the Fluent component card.

fluentIcon.description: Optional semantic icon key from iconcloud-fluent-icons.json. Label-based selection is used when omitted.

library.description: Optional explicit draw.io native library selection. When omitted, the generator infers a semantic library from the node.

shape.description: Optional draw.io native shape name within the selected library.

group.description: id of the group this node belongs to, if any

loopback.description: Semantic revision or return connector. Rendered in the revision color with a dedicated loop rail.

undirected.description: Render without an arrowhead (association, e.g. shared volume mount)
